<p class="eyebrow">Experience & approach</p>
<h1>I work where biological complexity meets therapeutic decisions.</h1>
<p>My background spans antibody immunotherapies, precision oncology, developmental neurobiology and computational tool building. Across those settings, my role is consistent: structure ambiguous questions, connect evidence across modalities and communicate what the data can—and cannot—support.</p>

<p class="section-index">Profile</p>
<h2 id="profile-title">Computational biologist with 6+ years across industry and academia.</h2>
<p>I combine deep biological context with hands-on analysis and software engineering. That means I can move from experimental design and QC to multi-omic integration, statistical modelling, interpretation and a result that an experimental or clinical team can use.</p>
<p>I hold a PhD in Bioinformatics and two MSc degrees in Bioinformatics & Biostatistics and Molecular Biology. I have worked in Spain, Germany, the United Kingdom and Sweden, and collaborate comfortably across disciplines and cultures.</p>
